kelvin_hint: Ukuthi isikrini sibukeka sifudumele kangakanani. Okuphansi kufudumele kakhulu.
density_hint: Ukuthi umbala ofudumele usetshenziswa ngamandla kangakanani.
extra_dim_hint: Kwenza isikrini sibe mnyama ngaphansi komkhawulo waso wezingxenyekazi.
colour_only_warning: Ukufudumeza kuphela kusiza kancane. Faka ukufiphaza okwengeziwe ukuze kube nomphumela wangempela.
preset_reset_all_confirm: Lokhu kubuyisela amaphrofayela afakiwe kumanani awo okuqala. Amaphrofayela akho agcinwa.
schedule_exact_alarm_desc: Ngaphandle kwalemvume ishejuli ingephuza imizuzu embalwa.
permission_overlay_desc: I-DoctorFilter idinga imvume yokudweba phezu kwezinye izinhlelo. Ngaphandle kwayo isihlungi asikwazi ukuvela esikrinini sakho.
permission_overlay_required: Isihlungi sidinga imvume yokudweba phezu kwezinye izinhlelo.
permission_battery_desc: Idivayisi yakho ingase imise isihlungi ngemuva ukonga ibhethri. Ukukhipha i-DoctorFilter ekulungiseni kwebhethri kuvimbela lokho.
settings_notification_desc: Lawula isihlungi kusuka kuphaneli yezaziso ngaphandle kokuvula uhlelo.
about_what_body: I-DoctorFilter ibeka umbala ofudumele, ongafiphazwa phezu kwesikrini sakho. Kusihlwa lokhu kunciphisa inani lokukhanya kwamagagasi amafushane okufinyelela emehlweni akho — ukukhanya umzimba wakho okufunda njengemini.
about_science_body: Amazinga okushisa ombala aguqulwa kusetshenziswa i-Planckian locus ku-CIE 1931 futhi abuyiselwe ku-Kelvin ngokuthola iphuzu eliseduze kuleyo curve, ngakho inombolo esesikrinini ihambisana nombala odwetshwayo ngempela. Isibalo sokunciphisa sisisho se-melanopic, ngokulandela i-CIE S 026, futhi sivela ngqo kuzibalo zesihlungi uqobo hhayi ekuqagelweni.
about_disclaimer_body: I-DoctorFilter akuyona idivayisi yezokwelapha. Ayihloli, ayelaphi futhi ayivimbeli noma yisiphi isimo, futhi ayithathi indawo yeseluleko sochwepheshe wamehlo. Uma amehlo akho ebuhlungu, ekhala, noma ukubona kwakho kushintsha, bona udokotela.
about_privacy_body: Konke kuhlala kule divayisi. Ayikho i-akhawunti, ayikho iseva futhi akukho ukuhlaziya. Izingxenye ezifinyelela ku-inthanethi yizona kuphela umhlinzeki wezikhangiso kanye nesitolo sakho sezinhlelo lapho uthenga i-Pro.
about_open_source_body: Ikhodi yomthombo egcwele ishicilelwe ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-GPL-3.0, ngakho ungazibonela ukuthi lolu hlelo lwenzani ngempela.
app_share_text: I-DoctorFilter — isihlungi sokukhanya okuluhlaza esikukhombisa izibalo zangempela. Umthombo ovulekile futhi simahhala.
pro_owned_detail: Konke kuvuliwe. Siyabonga ngokusekela lolu hlelo.
pro_benefit_no_ads_detail: Zonke izikhangiso ziyanyamalala, kufaka phakathi nebhanela elingezansi.
pro_benefit_notification_detail: Shintsha phakathi kwawo wonke amaphrofayela futhi ulungise zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu ngaphandle kokuvula uhlelo.
pro_benefit_presets_detail: Yakha futhi uhlele amaphrofayela amaningi ngokuthanda kwakho.
pro_benefit_schedule_detail: Izihlungi ezehlukene zezinsuku zomsebenzi, izimpelasonto nomsebenzi weshifu.
pro_no_subscription_note: Inkokhelo eyodwa, ingeyakho ingunaphakade. I-DoctorFilter ayinakho ukubhalisa nokuthi i-akhawunti — izilungiselelo zakho azikaze zishiye le divayisi.
pro_payment_note: Kukhokhwa ngesitolo sakho sezinhlelo, ngendlela yokukhokha esivele ikhona ku-akhawunti yakho.
pro_try_with_ad: Buka isikhangiso uthole amahora angu-{hours} e-Pro
purchase_pending: Ukuthenga kwakho kuyacutshungulwa. I-Pro izovuleka lapho nje kuphothulwa.
purchase_nothing_to_restore: Akukho ukuthenga kwangaphambilini okutholakele kule akhawunti.
reward_not_earned: Isikhangiso asiqedwanga, ngakho ayikho imvume enikeziwe.
edu_spectrum_body: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kusukela cishe ku-380 kuya ku-780 nm. Eceleni kwamaseli obona ngawo, amehlo akho aphethe ama-receptor aqukethe i-melanopsin azwela kakhulu cishe ku-480 nm. Awufaki kakhulu ekuboneni — atshela ubuchopho bakho ukuthi yisiphi isikhathi sosuku.
edu_kelvin_body: I-Kelvin ichaza umbala womthombo wokukhanya ngokuwuqhathanisa nento eshisisiwe. Ilangabi lekhandlela liseduze ne-1850 K, ilambu elifudumele liseduze ne-2700 K, kanti ukukhanya kwemini phakathi kwemini kungaphezu kwe-5500 K. Uma inombolo iphansi, kuncane ukukhanya kwamagagasi amafushane.
edu_melanopic_body: Abacwaningi balinganisa ukukhanya kwakusihlwa nge-melanopic EDI. Isivumelwano sochwepheshe sango-2022 sincoma ukuhlala ngaphansi kwe-10 lx ye-melanopic EDI emahoreni amathathu ngaphambi kokulala, nangaphansi kwe-1 lx ngesikhathi ulele. I-DoctorFilter ikhombisa ukuthi izilungiselelo zamanje zikuhambisa kangakanani kuleyo ndlela.
edu_dimming_body: Ucwaningo lwango-2019 nge-Night Shift ka-Apple lwathola ukuthi ukushintsha umbala wesikrini ngaphandle kokwehlisa ukukhanya akukunciphisanga ngendlela ebalulekile ukucindezelwa kwe-melatonin. Imibala efudumele iyasiza, kodwa i-slider yokufiphaza okwengeziwe yenza ingxenye enkulu yomsebenzi.
edu_strain_body: Ukukhathala kwesikrini kubangelwa ikakhulukazi ukungacwayizi kaningi, ukugxila kokusondele amahora amaningi, nomoya owomile — hhayi ukukhanya okuluhlaza. Ukubuyekezwa kwe-Cochrane kwango-2023 kwezivivinyo ezingu-17 kwathola ukuthi izibuko ezihlunga ukukhanya okuluhlaza cishe azenzi mehluko ekukhathaleni kwamehlo. Iseluleko esithembekile yirula le-20-20-20: njalo ngemizuzu engu-20, bheka into ekude ngamamitha angu-6 imizuzwana engu-20. Cwayiza ngamabomu.
edu_sources_note: Brown nabanye, PLOS Biology 2022 · Nagare nabanye, 2019 · Singh nabanye, Cochrane 2023 · CIE S 026:2018
onboarding_welcome_body: I-DoctorFilter yenza isikrini sakho sifudumale futhi sifiphale kusihlwa, futhi ikukhombisa izibalo eziqotho ngalokho ekwenzayo.
onboarding_permission_body: Ukuze ifake umbala kuso sonke isikrini, i-Android idinga imvume yakho yokudweba phezu kwezinye izinhlelo. Akukho okufundwayo esikrinini sakho — kudwetshwa nje phezu kwaso.
onboarding_ready_body: Khetha iphrofayela, noma ulungise wena ama-slider amathathu. Konke okushintshayo kulondolozwa ngokushesha.
settings_amoled_desc: Iphikseli elicishiwe alikhiphi ukukhanya nhlobo futhi lisebenzisa ibhethri elincane.
settings_backup_desc: Ilondoloza amaphrofayela akho nezilungiselelo zesihlungi njengefayela.
schedule_transition_desc: Isihlungi sifika kancane kancane hhayi ngasikhathi sinye.
settings_theme_follows_desc: Uhlelo olukhanyayo esikrinini esifiphele luchitha lokho isihlungi ebesikwenzile.
settings_usage_desc: Isikhathi sesikrini esihlungiwe kuleli sonto. Sihlala kule divayisi.
settings_breaks_desc: Njalo ngemizuzu engu-20, bheka cishe amamitha angu-6 ukude imizuzwana engu-20.
settings_breaks_locked: Imizuzu engu-20 yisikhawu ubufakazi obukhuluma ngaso. I-Pro ingasishintsha.
melanopic_target_explainer: Isivumelwano sochwepheshe sibeka ukukhanya kwakusihlwa ku-10 lx ye-melanopic EDI noma ngaphansi emahoreni amathathu ngaphambi kokulala. Alukho uhlelo olungalinganisa leso sibalo: sincike esikrinini sakho, ekukhanyeni kwaso nokuthi usibamba kude kangakanani. Indandatho ikhombisa ukuthi izilungiselelo zakho zisusa ukukhanya okungakanani okuthinta iwashi lomzimba uma kuqhathaniswa nesikrini esingahlungiwe, kumelwe ukwehla kuka-70 % njengesikhundla esifanele senhloso. Kuwumkhombandlela, hhayi isilinganiso.
schedule_bedtime_desc: Isikrini siqala ukwehla amahora amathathu ngaphambi kokulala — nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kufaka nokulala emini ngemva kweshifu yasebusuku.
preset_share_text: Zama leli phrofayela le-DoctorFilter — faka ikhodi ethi {code} ohlelweni.
calibration_desc: Hambisa uhlelo nalokho isikrini sakho esikukhombisa ngempela.
calibration_intro: Bamba iphepha elimhlophe eceleni kwesikrini sakho ekukhanyeni okujwayelekile. Lungisa uze ubone ibhokisi elingezansi libukeka njengephepha.
calibration_filter_off: Vula isihlungi ukuze ubone ukulungiswa esikrinini sangempela hhayi kuleli bhokisi kuphela.
oled_energy: Isikrini sakho sikhipha cishe {percent}% kokukhanya okuncane. Esikrinini se-OLED ukusetshenziswa kwamandla nakho kuyehla, nakuba kungafani ncamashi.
settings_ambient_desc: Ifiphaza kancane ngaphezulu ebumnyameni, iyahoxa ekukhanyeni kwemini.
exclusions_intro: Isihlungi siyaziphakamisa uma olunye lwalezi zinhlelo luphambili, bese sibuya uma uphuma.
exclusions_permission_body: Ukuze idedele ikhamera yakho, uhlelo ludinga ukwazi ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo oluphambili. I-Android ibiza lokhu ngokuthi ukufinyelela kokusebenzisa futhi uyakunikeza ezilungiselelweni zesistimu. I-DoctorFilter ifunda kuphela igama lohlelo oluvulekile ngaleso sikhathi, akukaze kube umlando wakho, futhi akukho okuphuma efonini yakho.
